Agent response: Nice — here’s a simple, safe plan to get the most from that pairing without overcomplicating things.Step 1 — transition slowly- Start by mixing the Freeze‑Dried Raw meal into your dog’s current food: about 25% new meal / 75% old food for 2–3 days, then 50/50 for 2–3 days, then 75/25 for 2–3 days, then full swap. Move slower if your dog has a very sensitive gut. - Keep treats and extras minimal during the transition so any changes in stool or appetite are easier to interpret.Step 2 — use the products as intended- Follow the product label for the Digestion Chews dosing (give daily as directed). Probiotics work best when given consistently every day. - Use the Freeze‑Dried Booster as a topper: sprinkle or mix a small scoop into each meal to increase palatability and whole‑food nutrients. You can use it during transition and after.Step 3 — preparation and serving- Rehydrate freeze‑dried meals with a little warm water (a splash to soak for 1–2 minutes) if your dog prefers softer texture or has trouble with dry food — this can be gentler on digestion. - Serve at regular times each day and keep portion sizes consistent. Avoid free‑feeding during the adjustment.Step 4 — watch the signals- Expect minor, brief changes early on (small stool changes, slight sneezing with strong smells), but look for steady appetite and firm, regular stools within about 7–14 days. - If loose stool, vomiting, or marked appetite loss continues for more than 48–72 hours, pause the new food and check with your vet or try our Televet service.Step 5 — storage, consistency, and follow‑up- Keep all products sealed in a cool, dry place.
